scope: NFL football team, unit, player, play, drive, game, and season analytics

metrics.name: Success rate
metrics.definition: Share of plays meeting the declared success rule
caveats: Success rule must be declared and may differ by team context
Small samples should not be generalized
metrics.validation_method: reconcile numerator and denominator to play ledger

metrics.name: Explosive play rate
metrics.definition: Share of eligible plays meeting the configured explosive threshold
caveats: Threshold and play eligibility must be explicit
Field position and game state affect opportunity
metrics.validation_method: check threshold logic and reconcile play IDs

metrics.name: Pressure rate
metrics.definition: Share of eligible opponent dropbacks with a credited pressure event
caveats: Credit definitions must be team/source-specific
Pressure opportunity is not identical to sack opportunity
metrics.validation_method: cross-check event-level film and charting lineage

metrics.name: Missed tackle rate
metrics.definition: Share of credited tackle opportunities recorded as misses
caveats: Opportunity definitions vary by charting source
Player comparison requires role and opportunity context
metrics.validation_method: review event sample and duplicate-event checks

metrics.name: Third-down conversion rate
metrics.definition: Share of eligible third-down plays converting the line-to-gain
caveats: Penalty and turnover treatment must be declared
Distance buckets materially change interpretation
metrics.validation_method: reconcile every third-down event to drive ledger

metrics.name: Red-zone efficiency
metrics.definition: Share of red-zone trips reaching the declared scoring outcome
caveats: Outcome definition must distinguish touchdown, field goal, turnover, and empty trip
Trip segmentation must be stable
metrics.validation_method: reconcile drive IDs to scoring ledger

metrics.name: Expected points added per play
metrics.definition: Mean change in expected points attributable to eligible plays under the declared model
caveats: Model version and state-space must be retained
Mean values are sensitive to explosive plays and garbage-time rules
metrics.validation_method: recompute from versioned state transitions and reconcile play IDs

metrics.name: Third-down conversion rate
metrics.definition: Share of eligible third-down plays converting the line-to-gain
caveats: Penalty and turnover treatment must be declared
Distance buckets materially change interpretation
metrics.validation_method: reconcile every third-down event to drive ledger

metrics.name: Completion rate
metrics.definition: Share of eligible forward pass attempts recorded as completed
caveats: Spikes, throwaways, defensive penalties, and charting corrections require explicit treatment
Completion rate does not measure pass value by itself
metrics.validation_method: reconcile attempts, completions, and exclusions to play ledger

metrics.name: Rushing efficiency
metrics.definition: Average rushing yards per eligible rushing attempt with declared kneel and sack treatment
caveats: Average is not success rate; explosive-play mix must be shown
Kneels and scrambles require declared classification
metrics.validation_method: reconcile rush attempt IDs and yardage totals to gamebook and film ledger

metrics.name: Sack rate
metrics.definition: Share of eligible opponent dropbacks ending in a credited sack
caveats: Sack credit and penalty treatment must follow the declared source policy
Pressure without a sack is excluded and should be reported separately
metrics.validation_method: reconcile sack events to dropback and film evidence

metrics.name: Kicking field-position start rate
metrics.definition: Share of eligible kicking plays producing a start at or beyond the declared field-position threshold
caveats: Threshold and touchback, return, penalty, and weather treatment must be explicit
Field-position benefit should be paired with return and coverage context
metrics.validation_method: reconcile kick IDs to field-position and possession ledger

quality_rules: Every observation references one dictionary definition
Context and source lineage are mandatory
Rates include sample size and uncertainty
